title: Owlshift personal configuration
description: The personal file, in the user's configuration directory, never committed.

allow_gate_env.description:
Names of variables of this machine's environment that a project may
pass to its agents by declaring them in `stack.gate_env`, in any
letter case. A project's declaration never widens this list: a name
declared but not listed here is refused. It applies to every project
run on this machine. A credential variable, a `GIT_` name, a variable
Owlshift overrides or one that makes the dynamic loader load code
cannot be listed.

concurrent_runs.description: How many runs this machine runs at once.

keep_awake.description: Whether to keep the machine awake while runs are in flight.

requires.description:
The Owlshift versions that can read this file: a semantic version
requirement such as `>=0.4`.

Harness.description: A harness: a vendor CLI that runs one role headless.

budget_usd.description: A dollar budget, only for a harness configured for API billing.

fallback.description: The harness to use when this one is at its usage limit.

Identity.description: The user's accounts on the tracker and the forge.
